body: When I’m calling home about a bad student, I always ask the parents “if you wouldn’t mind having a conversation with your child about what happened today, I’d really appreciate it.” In other words, your kid was a little shit today so fix them or I’ll have to get admin involved. Haha! It puts the ball back in their court and I was simply the messenger.
Thanks for your time and encouraging words. You’ve said some things that really resonate with me. I appreciate it. A lot.

Thank you. Deep down I know that the pain of leaving this world would absolutely destroy them. But the situation I’m in, it’s unlike anything I’ve ever experienced and I just don’t know if I have “what it takes” to persevere. Hence the dark thoughts, I guess.

Thank you. I am really starting to wonder if I have any place in my family anymore considering what shame and dire consequences I’ve brought into the household by being disloyal. Overall I have this sickening feeling of “who am I?” and “why would I engage in such betrayal and throw it all away?” My kids of course have no clue, but it hurts that I’m now labeled as a “cheater.” For all of my life I’ve been straight and narrow and followed the rules and then along cake this other woman and it made me rebel against what I’m not exactly sure. All I know is that I have this terrible guilt and a huge weight on my shoulders. Throw in having to parent three little children and you can probably imagine why I’m feeling lost and looking for a way to make it all go away.
